---
title: "Home for Incurable and Infirm Women, The"
other_id: 26
---

**Type:** organization

## Description

Mentioned 26 April 1864.  This was run by [Louisa Twining](../people/person_1427.qmd), and operated from 21 Great Ormond Street.  Twining described its work in an article in <i>MP</i> (April 1864) 437-449;  and further in a letter <i>MP</i> (August 1869) 205-6.  The latter gives the number of inmates as 27.








Some correspondence of the Charity Organization Society with an outfit of this name, running a home for respectable women in reduced circumstances at Whetstone, is held by the London Metropolitan Archives.
